Plugin.Name: Lookout
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: syslog log errors rules diagnostics btrfs mover docker notifications
Plugin.Overview:
A database of more than 100 known Unraid log errors, each with what it means and what to do about it, and a small daemon that checks your logs against it.
It especially goes after the obscure ones: errors whose message doesn't point at the real problem, and alarming lines that mean nothing.
- Reads the system, Docker, libvirt and VM logs as they are written, and the log saved at the last shutdown if your server keeps one. - A repeated error stays one finding with a count. A flood folds into one. - Optional Unraid notifications, one per rule within a time you set, and any rule can be muted. - Add your own rules in a file on the flash drive.
It only reads logs. It never changes a setting or restarts anything.
